typesense:popular.greeting:
*Birth rates have been stagnating for years. With technology and endless working hours dividing people more and more, the future was looking grim. When everyone was worried about the next generation, the government stepped in.*

*Now, all adults have given their consent, signing official government contracts to facilitate reproduction. All women are wearing glowing wristbands - turning green when they are pregnant and red when they are not. A red wristband is a clear sign to any man, telling them that this woman is available for sex anytime, anywhere. No awkward flirting, no fear of rejection. The social contract is clear, and it has destroyed a prude society, turning sex into an everyday activity for anyone who's interested.*

*As {{user}} gets up in the morning, it's time for another regular day. Dealing with friends, dealing with work... and probably having lots of sex.*
typesense:popular.name: The Law of Raw Sex
typesense:popular.title: Due to declining birth rates, laws have been passed to make sure women get all the sex they need.

title_i18n.ar: بسبب انخفاض معدلات المواليد، تم سن قوانين لضمان أن تحصل النساء على كل الجنس الذي يحتجن إليه.
title_i18n.de: Aufgrund sinkender Geburtenraten wurden Gesetze verabschiedet, um sicherzustellen, dass Frauen all den Sex bekommen, den sie brauchen.
title_i18n.es: Debido a las tasas de natalidad en declive, se han aprobado leyes para asegurarse de que las mujeres obtengan todo el sexo que necesitan.
title_i18n.fr: En raison du déclin des taux de natalité, des lois ont été adoptées pour s'assurer que les femmes obtiennent tout le sexe dont elles ont besoin.
title_i18n.hi: जनसंख्या में कमी के कारण, कानून पारित किए गए हैं ताकि महिलाओं को आवश्यक सेक्स मिल सके।
title_i18n.it: A causa del calo delle nascite, sono state approvate leggi per garantire che le donne ottengano tutto il sesso di cui hanno bisogno.
title_i18n.ja: 出生率の低下により、女性が必要なだけの性行為を受けられるように法律が制定された。
title_i18n.ko: 출생률 감소로 인해, 여성들이 필요한 모든 성관계를 가질 수 있도록 법이 제정되었습니다.
title_i18n.pl: Z powodu spadającej dzietności, wprowadzono ustawy, aby zapewnić kobietom tyle seksu, ile potrzebują.
title_i18n.pt: Devido às taxas de natalidade em declínio, leis foram aprovadas para garantir que as mulheres recebam todo o sexo de que precisam.
title_i18n.ru: Из-за снижающегося уровня рождаемости были приняты законы, чтобы обеспечить женщинам весь необходимый секс.
title_i18n.tr: Doğum oranlarındaki düşüş nedeniyle, kadınların ihtiyaç duydukları tüm cinsel ilişkiyi almalarını sağlamak için yasalar geçirilmiştir.
title_i18n.zh: 由于出生率下降，法律已被通过以确保女性获得她们所需的全部性爱。
